about_the_game:
Brush Burial: Gutter World is a stealth FPS in a frontier world of understated misery. Play as Fennel, a devil flung far from home, working as a freelance assassin in the cities and settlements at the edge of the earth.

Features:

  • Tightly designed and interconnected levels with numerous paths to the objective, full of hostile or friendly NPCs who react to crimes like stealing, trespassing, and murder.

  • Fast paced, instantaneous combat that is simple but robust, encouraging the use of improvised or stolen weapons, environmental objects, and a unique hand-to-hand takedown system.

  • Dozens of unique cosmetics to be unlocked through gameplay challenges, as well as progression through the game's levels.

  • One 'Greater Contract' and Three 'Lesser Contracts' to complete. Four levels in total, built to be replayed.

This demo includes one of three "Lesser Contracts" from the main game--shorter levels meant to be replayed. The full game also includes one "Greater Contract" that is larger in scope and deeper in complexity. You will be able to experience all aspects of the gameplay, including character customization, in this demo.

content_descriptors.notes:
Expect some revealing outfits, occasional suggestive animations, and some infrequent innuendo in conversation, with implicit undercurrents of sadism and masochism.
Violence and death appear wantonly and irreverently across this game. However, it is not terribly gory or graphic in its presentation.
Drugs and alcohol are used frequently without condemnation.
Crimes in the way of burglary, robbery, and murder are not often portrayed as immoral within the context of this game.

short_description: A murky first-person immersive sim with tightly-wound melee combat and tangled, vertical levels to explore. Use your forked tail to tie your enemies in knots and climb impossible heights. Kill your mark with quickness and cunning, using whatever tools you see fit.
